papers.title: Flat optics for analog computing: from fundamental mechanisms to advanced meta-processors
papers.abstract: As the explosive growth of visual data increasingly strains the latency and energy limits of conventional electronic computing, optical analog computing has re-emerged as a disruptive paradigm for zero-power, speed-of-light information processing. Propelled by the unprecedented wave-manipulation capabilities of optical metasurfaces, this field is undergoing a rapid transition from macroscopic physical optics to ultra-compact, on-chip meta-processors. This Review examines the fundamental mechanisms of metasurface-empowered optical computing spanning Fourier-domain, nonlocal spatial-domain, and interferometric architectures that perform mathematical operations, with a particular focus on spatial differentiation and edge detection as representative computing tasks. By emphasizing recent breakthroughs, we highlight the evolution of meta-processors from static, linear regimes to dynamically reconfigurable, nonlinear, and quantum-assisted multidimensional platforms. We also envision how the synergy of AI-driven inverse design and the integration of analog meta-front-ends with optical neural networks will synergistically revolutionize next-generation intelligent machine vision.

analysis.summary: 综述超表面赋能的光学模拟计算机制与进展，从傅里叶域、微分运算到动态可重构元处理器，展望低功耗高速光学计算新范式。
analysis.research思路: 针对视觉数据处理中电子计算的延迟与能耗瓶颈，探索基于超表面的光学模拟计算实现数学运算，重点突破空间微分与边缘检测。
analysis.experiment: 采用超表面波前工程实现傅里叶变换与空间微分，涵盖干涉仪架构与非局部响应机制，演示从静态线性到动态可重构系统的演进。
analysis.innovation: 首次系统综述超表面光学计算从基础机制到多维平台的完整发展路径，实现从宏观光学向芯片级元处理器的技术跨越。
analysis.related_work: 涵盖基于傅里叶光学的传统模拟计算、超表面波前调控、非线性光学处理及量子光学计算等领域的代表性工作。
analysis.impact: 为下一代零功耗、低延迟计算提供技术路线图，推动光学计算从实验室演示向实际应用转化，对AI视觉处理意义重大。

domain_trend.trend: 超表面驱动的多功能光学系统正从实验室走向实际应用，融合光学计算、AI感知与生物传感，朝着芯片级低功耗智能光学处理器方向发展。
key_topics: 超表面光学计算与模拟信号处理
等离子体纳米结构增强机理与应用
光学传感与环境纳米塑料检测
可重构多功能集成光子器件
domain_trend.development_direction: 该领域正朝着三大方向演进：(1)超表面赋能的光学模拟计算向低功耗、高并行、动态可重构方向发展，为AI视觉处理提供物理层加速；(2)等离子体纳米天线通过几何工程调控光-物质相互作用，实现高灵敏传感与高效光源；(3)环境/生物检测向快速、原位、低成本技术演进，SSBD等新技术将推动纳米塑料等新兴污染物检测。未来趋势是多功能集成——在同一芯片上融合计算、感知、调控功能，实现智能光学系统的片上化。

papers.title: Toroidal Plasmonic Nanodimers for Enhanced Near-Infrared Emission in Heterostructured InP Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Near-infrared (NIR) emitters operating in the 650-900 nm range are highly attractive for imaging and sensing in turbid media; however, cadmium-free InP-based quantum dots (QDs) often suffer from limited brightness due to nonradiative pathways and inefficient photon outcoupling. In particular, heterostructured InP QDs can exhibit band alignments that induce partial spatial separation of charge carriers, leading to reduced electron-hole wavefunction overlap. This modifies intrinsic recombination dynamics and enhances the sensitivity of their emission to the surrounding photonic environment. Here, we investigate silver toroidal plasmonic nanoantenna dimers (Ag TPNDs) through finite-difference-time-domain (FDTD) simulations as a geometry-tunable platform for enhancing NIR emission of heterostructured InP-based QDs. The coupled toroidal geometry supports strongly confined bonding modes that generate intense nanogap hotspots, while its resonance can be systematically tuned through the toroid aspect ratio. By spectrally aligning the antenna response with QD emission bands (675-845 nm), we achieve large Purcell enhancements together with high quantum efficiencies, demonstrating efficient conversion of enhanced decay rates into radiative emission. We further show that nanometer-scale variations in emitter-antenna separation strongly modulate the radiative rates and spectral response. These results establish toroidal plasmonic nanodimers as a topology-driven platform for controlling emission in NIR quantum emitters and for advancing NIR nanophotonic applications.

analysis.summary: 通过FDTD模拟研究银环形等离子体纳米天线二聚体，利用其强约束键合模式和纳米间隙热点，显著增强异质结构InP量子点的近红外发射。
analysis.research思路: 针对不含镉InP量子点因载流子空间分离和非辐射复合导致的亮度受限问题，利用等离子体纳米天线调控其周围光子环境，从而优化辐射复合动力学。
analysis.experiment: 采用有限差分时域(FDTD)仿真方法，构建可调几何参数的银环形纳米天线二聚体模型，系统模拟其共振特性与量子点发射的耦合效果。
analysis.innovation: 引入环形几何结构产生强约束键合模式，首次系统研究TPNDs几何参数与共振波长的构效关系，实现对近红外区域的精确调谐。
analysis.related_work: 量子点等离子体增强领域、等离子体纳米天线设计、InP基近红外发光材料、以及异质结构量子点的载流子动力学调控研究。
analysis.impact: 为开发高效无镉近红外光源提供了新思路，推动等离子体纳米天线在生物成像和传感领域的应用，尤其对650-900nm波段器件设计具有重要指导意义。

papers.title: Ultrasensitive Nanoplastics Detection Leveraging Shrinking Surface Plasmonic Bubble
papers.abstract: Nanoplastics pose serious environmental and health risks due to their widespread presence in aquatic systems. Detecting trace amounts of nanoplastics is a challenging task, which currently requires sophisticated equipment and tedious sample preparation (e.g., ultrafiltration). In this work, we demonstrate an ultra-sensitive Shrinking Surface Bubble Deposition (SSBD) technique for nanoplastics detection. SSBD leverages plasmonic photothermal effects to generate a surface bubble and the resulting Marangoni flow to concentrate sparsely suspended nanoplastics onto the bubble surface. The collected nanoplastic particles are subsequently deposited on the substrate after the bubble shrinks and vanishes. To quantify the detection limit of SSBD for nanoplastics in water, core-shell gold plasmonic nanoparticles are mixed with the aqueous sample to enable photothermal bubble generation, while also supporting surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) for signal enhancement. Results show that the limits of detection are 10 ng/mL, 10-1 ng/mL and 10-3 ng/mL for polystyrene (PS) particles with diameters of 500 nm, 200 nm and 30 nm, respectively. We further used SSBD to detect plastics particles in real drinking water (e.g., bottled and fountain water) and found polyamides (PA) and polypropylene (PP) micro/nanoplastics, demonstrating the potential of the SSBD-SERS technique as a versatile and sensitive platform for detecting trace-level nanoplastic contamination and assessing human exposure risk.

analysis.summary: 开发了SSBD技术，利用等离子体光热效应产生表面气泡和Marangoni流动实现纳米塑料的快速富集与SERS检测，无需复杂设备即可实现超灵敏检测。
analysis.research思路: 解决水体中痕量纳米塑料难以检测的问题，突破传统方法需要超滤等繁琐样品准备的局限，实现对稀疏悬浮纳米塑料的原位富集与高灵敏检测。
analysis.experiment: 采用核壳结构金等离子体纳米粒子混合样品溶液，通过激光照射产生光热气泡，Marangoni流动将纳米塑料输运至气泡表面，气泡收缩后颗粒沉积于基底进行SERS分析。
analysis.innovation: 创新性结合气泡生成与SERS增强双功能，利用Marangoni流动实现选择性富集，气泡收缩过程自然完成样品沉积，避免了传统过滤和浓缩步骤。
analysis.related_work: 纳米塑料检测领域涉及超滤分离、荧光标记、质谱分析等技术；SERS检测方面有各种纳米结构基底研究；光热气泡操控粒子方面有微流控和液滴蒸发相关工作。
analysis.impact: 为环境水中纳米塑料的原位快速检测提供了新思路，降低了对精密仪器和复杂操作的依赖，有望推动纳米塑料环境监测技术的实用化发展。
